description: Returns all Recycled Action Plan Items for a given Project

parameters.name: filters[created_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) created within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-...

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[plan_section_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) associated with the specified Action Plan Section(s).

parameters.name: filters[plan_id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) associated with the specified Action Plan ID(s)

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYY...

id.description: Unique identifier for this recycled Action Plan Item.

created_at.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 format when this item was created.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 format when this item was deleted.

description.description: Detailed description of the work or inspection required for this item.

due_at.description: Due date for this item in ISO 8601 format. Null if no due date was set.

holding_type.description: Action Plan Item holding type specifies whether the current item holds all the succeeding items in the section or the plan

is_blocked.description: Indicates whether current Action Plan Item is blocked by another Action Plan Item

is_blocking.description: Indicates whether current Action Plan Item is blocking other Action Plan Items

notes.description: Free-text notes attached to this Action Plan Item.

plan_id.description: ID of the Action Plan this recycled item belonged to.

position.description: Ordinal position of this item within its section at the time of deletion.

plan_section_id.description: ID of the section this recycled item belonged to.

id.description: Unique identifier for the item status.

name.description: Name of the status. Possible values: open, in_progress, delayed, closed.

template_item_id.description: ID of the plan template item this item was generated from. Null if the item was created directly rather than from a template.

title.description: Short title summarizing the inspection or task for this recycled item.

updated_at.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 format when this item was last updated.
